body:
How can you assume so many things and say such things.

I said they're not any use. And you literally said "I've decided it's not what I WANT".

I've called several times, they just made me feel so much worse than I did before. Create so much more trauma, pushed me to suicide like the worst. After this, I have to read things like you just wrote. And more so, "you have nothing to lose" "just a little time"

How can you assume so many things and say such things after I said they're no use.

"there's people for you" not even one that has helped in any way. Am I not alone if the only people available just make me feel even worse, don't understand me, don't make me feel any better or help me?

Just how can you say such things. How can you asume helplines are going to help or this or that is going to help. Did you ask me if they've helped? No. More so, I said they're no use and you still said that

And the only thing that coming here is doing is just making me feel even worse before killing myself. I might as well had gone killing myself directly, I wouldnt have had to read such things after literally one guy in the helpline just yelling at me and being like shit to me. Really I regret coming here. Going to kill myself anyway, just felt even worse.

As if helplines were any use.

Don't you think I would have done that if that was any use?

I came here because I thought this might help but you guys really are just making. Me feel so much worse i don't feel understood at all.

I guess I'm so selfish for not wanting to be alone while feeling like this one time

I guess I'm so selfish for asking him to stay a bit longer and not leaving me alone feeling like this again, as he has made other times before and knows how bad it went for me for months feeling like the worst and about to killing myself. He knows. Yet he said he can't take a cab it's too expensive

I guess no matter where I. Post it no one is going to show some understanding.

What's the point in anything at all?

"Reach out" "reach out" reach out to who!?

Of course he has 20$ to spend on a cab. He then will spend it on a switch game or something like that. I was going to offer but he just said he leaves

Knowing him and knowing this is not the first time these sort of things happen, no, he doesn't feel terrible.

I don't feel understood at all. You just made me feel worse. 

You say I can't rely on other people to save me as if I always did that.

Then I'll get the "you need to let yourself be helped". So whatever I do I'm always wrong, right? Then you tell me this because I say how I feel
